summary: Software autofocus over a Z stack. Required for the Autofocus widget.

fields.label: Detector
fields.tip: Detector used to grab focus-search frames.

fields.label: Z Positioner
fields.tip: Z positioner stepped during the search.

fields.label: Update freq (Hz)
fields.tip: Update rate of the autofocus plot, in hertz.

fields.label: Crop X
fields.tip: Starting X of the focus-metric region.

fields.label: Crop Y
fields.tip: Starting Y of the focus-metric region.

fields.label: Settle time (ms)
fields.tip: Wait after each Z move before the focus metric's frame is taken, in milliseconds. The frame is taken through the same fresh-frame handshake tiling uses, so a camera slower than this wait still yields a frame that started exposing after the move.
